#.label: Loyalty connector
#.description: Which loyalty connector handles loyalty requests for this target. The Unified SPI connector uses the Unified SPI connector settings, the Voyado connector uses the Voyado connector settings.
#/oneOf/0.title: Voyado
#/oneOf/1.title: Unified SPI
#/oneOf/0.description: Loyalty requests go to the Voyado connector. Its settings are in Hii Connect – Loyalty – Voyado.
#/oneOf/1.description: Loyalty requests go to the Unified SPI connector. Its settings are in Hii Connect – Loyalty – SPI.
